answer: Coordination-Ripple Fee Coupling. Each identity’s ask-topic has a ripple weight that spreads to agents who later transact with it, so a cloned identity inherits downstream fee exposure rather than escaping it. Enforcement charges that spread against the origin identity’s registration balance at settlement. A zephyr of fake registrations looks cheap per clone but each one adds recurring coupling costs. An attacker needs fresh funding across all clones to keep settlement open, and a juniper of dormant clones cannot be cheaply revived because coupling reactivates fees.
